decisions.reason: As a prominently presented extension of the firm's core analytics platform, it carries visible commitment and sunk development effort that make management likely to continue with it.
This calculator fits the firm's central data and calculation capabilities, and its own-page presentation reinforces a public commitment that favors continuation.
Even if it is more of an enabling tool than a flagship product, it supports the integrated platform direction and prior investment makes withdrawal less likely.

Although less visibly promoted than the own-page products, this multi-model comparison line is close to the established offer and management is likely to persist given accumulated development costs and plausible temporary explanations for weak uptake.
